result.title: Is This Your Agent? Identity Watermarking for Agent Systems in Dynamic Environments
result.summary: Agent systems deployed in dynamic environments continuously update their memories, skills, and runtime configurations, leading to evolving trajectories and challenges for persistent identity authentication. Existing text and agent watermarking methods struggle to achieve stable watermark embedding under dynamic environments, while embedded watermarks may become difficult to recover due to environmental changes. This paper proposes DASMark, an identity watermarking framework for dynamic agent systems. DASMark introduces Action-Preserving Embedding (APE), which learns semantically similar but distinguishable decision-expression channels from diverse interaction trajectories to enable stable watermark embedding in dynamic systems. It further introduces Shift-Robust Recovery (SRR) to mitigate context-induced shifts and improve watermark recovery stability under dynamic environments. In dynamic settings, DASMark achieves 98.5% bit-decoding accuracy and maintains 95.2% accuracy under attack scenarios, while preserving task utility comparable to unwatermarked agents.

AI.brief_summary: DASMark 提出面向动态环境中 agent 系统的身份水印框架，通过学习可区分的决策表达通道嵌入水印，并做抗漂移恢复以提升解码稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作关注 agent 身份认证与水印嵌入/恢复的鲁棒性，其「决策表达通道」是水印载体而非推理状态，与 latent visual reasoning 的表示、生成、证据使用或停止决策问题无实质联系，也无可核查的方法借鉴线索。
